messages:
zoe_support: urgent escalation 0 trials (BrightPath) report zero available seats after invite. Users see 'no seats available' UI. Reported 14:03 UTC, kickoff demo at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Marking P1 to protect renewal.

zoe_support: minimal log excerpt:
```json
{"org":"brightpath-trial-09","event":"seat_check","result":"0_available","ts":"2026-03-22T14:01:12Z","billing_status":"active","license_tier":"trial"}
```

inc_bot: Incident created: INC-2026-331; severity=high; auto-assigned to eng-runtime.

harry_cs: I can own comms. Please confirm impacted org ids + primary POCs and whether billing shows seats consumed. Need to craft short note for their admin and CSM. Renewal flagged in SFDC? @lucy_am can you confirm?

zoe_support: Affected orgs: brightpath-trial-09, brightpath-pilot-02. POCs: emily@brightpath.edu (CTO), raj@brightpath.edu (ops). Billing shows seats=100 purchased, seats_allocated=0. We'll attach support ticket ST-9911 with traces.

kim_runtime: Looking now. Early hypothesis: seat-sync job between billing-ledger and provisioning-service failed at 13:48 UTC due to S3 timeout; ledger reported seats but provisioning never reconciled. Quick mitigation: force a one-off sync for org via admin CLI: 
```bash
redwood-admin billing sync --org brightpath-trial-09 --force
```
That should restore seat counts in provisioning. I'll need ops signoff to run for trial orgs. Long-term fix: make sync idempotent + retry with backoff.

lucy_am: Please run the force sync now. We cannot let the demo fail. I'll update SFDC and ping customer. Adding renewal note: "high touch; demo tomorrow; temporary remediation applied".

kim_runtime: Executing force sync for both orgs. Will post result.

kim_runtime: Sync done for brightpath-trial-09 -> seats_allocated=100, invites proceed. Sync done for brightpath-pilot-02 -> seats_allocated=100. Verified invite flow returns 200 and UI reflects seats.

harry_cs: Great. Draft comms to send to Emily and Raj (short):
1) apology for interruption + brief cause (internal seat sync failed)
2) confirm immediate remediation applied (one-off sync) and invites should now work
3) offer 15-min check-in before demo to validate flows (propose 08:15 PT)
4) next steps: engineering tracking permanent fix and we'll share ETA + prevent recurrence

harry_cs: Sending now and cc'ing AM + eng. Will include meeting link for quick pre-demo validation.

zoe_support: Created change request CR-9753 authorizing forced sync. Also attached sync job logs and S3 timeout traces to INC-2026-331 and ST-9911.

inc_bot: Incident INC-2026-331 status -> mitigated (temporary fix); follow-up task created: TASK-5547 (make sync robust).

lucy_am: I've updated SFDC: renewal_flag=at_risk, next_touch=tomorrow_before_demo. Also prepared renewal cushioning: offer 2-week trial extension + one-month seat uplift if they choose annual within 30 days. Will discuss on call.

harry_cs: Recap / owners: (1) CS: send comms + schedule pre-demo check-in (harry_cs) (2) AM: renewal offer + join demo (lucy_am) (3) Eng: implement sync retry + monitoring (kim_runtime) (4) Support: keep ST-9911 open and watch invites (zoe_support).

zoe_support: Monitoring hooks added to provisioning-check stream and will alert if sync fails again. Leaving ST-9911 open until TASK-5547 delivered.

kim_runtime: I'll follow up with an ETA for the durable fix by EOD tomorrow and post a short postmortem in INC-2026-331.

harry_cs: Thanks all. I'm sending the customer note now and scheduling the 08:15 PT check. :white_check_mark:

inc_bot: Incident INC-2026-331 updated: note added by kim_runtime; status remains "monitoring" until TASK-5547 complete.
